name: @w6w-apps/ecwid
description: Manage an Ecwid store: products and stock, categories, orders, customers, discount coupons and the store profile.

w6w.longDescription:
Ecwid by Lightspeed is an eCommerce platform, and this app covers the store management a workflow actually automates: the product catalog and its stock, the category tree, orders from placement to fulfillment, customer records, discount coupons, and the store's own profile and settings.

Everything a store-run needs to react to is here. Search the catalog by keyword, SKU, category or availability and write products back with their variations' stock; move stock by delta so a sale or a return never clobbers a concurrent one; read and amend orders with their totals, addresses and statuses; find customers by name, email, phone or group and keep their consents and tax details straight; and create the coupons a campaign hands out. The store profile read returns the settings, languages, formats and company address that the rest of the store is configured from.

The connection is a single store — an Ecwid store id plus a custom app's secret access token, sent as a bearer token with the id in every request's path — which is the configuration Ecwid's own documentation recommends for single-store integrations instead of an OAuth app. Health checks follow Ecwid's own status page, keyed on its `API` component rather than the page-wide roll-up, and the app states plainly that Ecwid publishes no readable quota headroom rather than inventing a probe for it.
